decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing is a core installation component within the firm's compatible product families, so the firm stays committed to it despite no recent website visibility.
As the publicly announced flagship of the design-focused direction, the designer shower drain carries the strongest investment and reputational commitment, so management will persist with it.

The shower element with integrated slope fits the announced low-profile, integrated bathroom strategy, and weak visibility can still be blamed on pandemic-era market disruptions rather than the product itself.
The DallSafe 200 basement drain was publicly launched under the firm's name as a specialist solution, so the visible commitment and sunk development costs favor keeping it.
